Test Scenario: Successful login with valid credentials
Preconditions: Active, registered user exists.
Test Steps: 1. Open login page. 2. Enter email. 3. Enter password. 4. Click Log In.
Expected Result: Dashboard is displayed. Session cookie (or token) is created. Redirect URL = /dashboard.

Test Scenario: Invalid password – generic error
Preconditions: Active, registered user exists.
Test Steps: 1. Open login page. 2. Enter correct email. 3. Enter wrong password. 4. Click Log In.
Expected Result: Login page remains. Error message exactly "Invalid email or password". No session is created.

Test Scenario: Unregistered email – same generic error
Preconditions: No account exists for the provided email.
Test Steps: 1. Open login page. 2. Enter unregistered email. 3. Enter password. 4. Click Log In.
Expected Result: Login page remains. Error message "Invalid email or password" is shown. No session is created.

Test Scenario: Empty fields validation
Preconditions: Active, registered user exists.
Test Steps: 1. Open login page. 2. Leave email and password fields empty. 3. Click Log In.
Expected Result: Inline validation prompts to fill required fields. No request is sent to the server.

Test Scenario: Invalid email format
Preconditions: Active, registered user exists.
Test Steps: 1. Open login page. 2. Enter invalid email format. 3. Enter password. 4. Click Log In.
Expected Result: Inline message "Enter a valid email address" is displayed. No request is sent.

Test Scenario: Account lockout after consecutive failed attempts
Preconditions: Active, registered user exists.
Test Data: Email: user@example.com; Password: WrongPass! (used for 5 attempts)
Test Steps: 1. Open login page. 2. Attempt login with wrong password five times within 15 minutes. 3. Attempt login with correct password after the fifth failure.
Expected Result: After fifth failure, account is locked. When correct credentials are entered, message "Your account is locked. Try again later." is shown. No login occurs.

Test Scenario: Case sensitivity of email and password
Preconditions: Active, registered user exists.
Test Data: Email: USER@EXAMPLE.COM; Password: ValidPass123! (correct case) and Password: validpass123! (incorrect case)
Test Steps: 1. Open login page. 2. Enter email with different case but same letters. 3. Enter correct password case and click Log In – expect success. 4. Repeat with password case altered and click Log In – expect error.
Expected Result: Email case variation is accepted; login succeeds with correct password case. Password case variation is rejected with error "Invalid email or password".

Test Scenario: Session persistence after successful login
Preconditions: User has successfully logged in.
Test Steps: 1. Perform a successful login. 2. Refresh the browser without logging out.
Expected Result: User remains logged in; session persists for up to 24 hours. Dashboard remains accessible.

Test Scenario: Login attempt with inactive account
Preconditions: User account is deactivated.
Test Steps: 1. Open login page. 2. Enter email of inactive account. 3. Enter password. 4. Click Log In.
Expected Result: Error message "This account is inactive. Contact support." is displayed. User is not logged in and no session is created.

Test Scenario: Apply a valid percentage promo code (SAVE10) to a qualifying subtotal.
Preconditions: User is on the Checkout page; cart item‑subtotal = ₹1,000; no promo code applied.
Test Steps:
1. Verify item‑subtotal displayed as ₹1,000.
2. Enter SAVE10 into the promo code field.
3. Click the Apply button.
4. Observe the discount and total.
Expected Result: A 10% discount of ₹100 is applied; item‑subtotal becomes ₹900; order total updates accordingly.

Test Scenario: Apply a valid fixed‑amount promo code (FLAT200) when subtotal meets the minimum requirement.
Preconditions: User is on the Checkout page; cart item‑subtotal = ₹1,500; no promo code applied.
Test Steps:
1. Verify item‑subtotal displayed as ₹1,500.
2. Enter FLAT200 into the promo code field.
3. Click Apply.
4. Observe the discount and total.
Expected Result: ₹200 is deducted; item‑subtotal becomes ₹1,300; order total reflects the discounted amount.

Test Scenario: Attempt to apply a fixed‑amount promo code (FLAT200) when subtotal is below the required minimum.
Preconditions: User is on the Checkout page; cart item‑subtotal = ₹800; no promo code applied.

Test Scenario: Reapply a single‑use promo code that has already been redeemed by the same customer.

3. Click Apply.
4. Observe the response.
Expected Result: Error message displayed: "This code has already been used."; no additional discount applied; total remains unchanged.

Test Scenario: Apply a fixed‑amount promo code that would otherwise reduce subtotal below zero.

Test Steps:

2. Enter FLAT200 into the promo code field.
3. Click Apply.
4. Observe the discount and total.
Expected Result: Discount capped at ₹150; resulting subtotal is ₹0 (never negative); order total reflects ₹0 for items.

Test Scenario: Replace an already applied promo code with a new one after user confirmation.
Preconditions: User is on the Checkout page; cart item‑subtotal = ₹1,000; promo code SAVE10 already applied (₹100 discount).
Test Steps:
1. Verify existing discount of ₹100 from SAVE10.
2. Enter FLAT200 into the promo code field.
3. Click Apply.
4. System prompts: "A promo code is already applied. Replace it?".
5. Confirm replacement.
6. Observe the new discount and total.
Expected Result: SAVE10 discount removed; FLAT200 discount of ₹200 applied; item‑subtotal becomes ₹800; order total updates accordingly.

Test Scenario: Attempt to apply a promo code with an empty input field.

Test Steps:

2. Click the Apply button.
3. Observe the response.
Expected Result: Error message displayed: "Enter a promo code."; no discount applied; total remains unchanged.

Preconditions: User is on the Checkout page; cart item‑subtotal = ₹1,000; no promo code applied.
Test Steps:
1. Verify item‑subtotal displayed as ₹1,000.
2. Enter "  SAVE10  " into the promo code field.
3. Click Apply.
4. Observe the discount and total.
Expected Result: Whitespace is trimmed; code recognized as SAVE10; ₹100 discount applied; subtotal becomes ₹900; total updates.

Test Scenario: Re‑validate discount when cart subtotal changes after a promo code has been applied.
Preconditions: User is on the Checkout page; cart item‑subtotal = ₹1,200; promo code FLAT200 (requires ₹1,000 minimum) already applied.
Test Data: Cart change: remove an item reducing subtotal to ₹900.
Test Steps:
1. Verify FLAT200 discount of ₹200 applied; subtotal displayed as ₹1,000.
2. Remove an item causing subtotal to drop to ₹900.
3. System automatically re‑validates the applied promo code.
4. Observe the outcome.
Expected Result: FLAT200 is removed because the new subtotal is below the minimum; discount cleared; item‑subtotal returns to ₹900; total updates accordingly.
